player_intent: Quick Match finds a healthy compatible SOCOM server without requiring the player to type its address.
acceptance_rule: The browser-safe Supabase publishable key lists only operational or degraded regions and fresh online servers with capacity through SELECT-only anonymous RLS policies, converts each timestamptz heartbeat to last_heartbeat_unix, applies the canonical build and protocol selection policy, and returns one validated ws:// or wss:// endpoint without waiting for player identity.

nodes.role: Uses the browser-safe Supabase publishable key and returns normalized public directory data without opening a network peer or owning identity.

must_not_change: server shot, damage, movement, camera, animation, and weapon ownership

system_delta.reason: Merge public SELECT-only REST discovery and endpoint normalization with the existing pure selection policy. Live proof showed anonymous identity creation is disabled, and public server addresses do not require identity; preserve authentication for private player data and preserve the canonical session as the only connection owner.

current.system: Directory reads blocked behind guest authentication while anonymous sign-in is disabled in the deployed project

candidate.system: Public SELECT-only matchmaking directory that normalizes filtered rows and returns one validated WebSocket join contract without identity latency

visual_check: Open a clean browser profile with no guest session, use Quick Match, and confirm the directory responds immediately and enters the selected wss:// server. Player identity may remain Local Guest when anonymous sign-in is disabled; no directory client opens a peer itself.
